messages:
Aisha: FYI postmortem posted for the midnight throughput/latency regression on /generate. Need owners for remediation and temporary SLO relaxations.

slo-bot: INCIDENT: 2026-01-14 00:42 UTC 1% p95 increase, 8% error-budget burn in 45m. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260114-01

Tom: Root cause seems to be KV eviction spikes during a model rollout. Recommend temporary route-level SLO: /generate p95 -> 380ms for next 21d and block auto-rollouts for quantized-v3.

Jorge: I can take the KV tuning and eviction mitigation work (owner). ETA 4 business days for config + canary.

Priya: I'll add a per-route SLO panel in Grafana and an alert: error_budget_burn >7% over 30m -> notify #eng-oncall, >12% 1h -> page. Also add synthetic probe at 3 rps. ETA 48h.

Aisha: Action list: (1) Jorge - KV tuning & migration plan (4bd). (2) Priya - dashboard + alerts + synth (48h). (3) Tom - rollout block PR and gating (EOD tomorrow). (4) Aisha - update postmortem + SLO change note + email stakeholders (72h). Mark recurring-pattern threshold: if cache-evictions >2 in 90 days open epic.

Priya: Adding recording rule to count cache_eviction_bursts over 90d and wiring a webhook to #architecture if >2.

Tom: Will draft rollout block: `model_auto_rollouts: disabled for quantized-v3` and put in PR.

Jorge: I'll include rollback steps and performance test logs in the postmortem comments.

Aisha: OK. We'll revisit at weekly SLO review. If anyone slips on deadlines ping me. Closing thread for now.
